_meta.note: What each dose line's stock does to the nutrient solution, so the dose review can estimate EC and pH after a dose (contract 11.3). ecChangePerMlPerL: the EC rise in mS/cm from 1 mL of stock in 1 L of solution; phChangePerMlPerL: the pH change from the same (negative lowers pH). For a tank, divide by its litres: 120 mL of A into 936 L adds 120 x 0.47 / 936 = 0.06. Every dose line in layout.json needs an entry. These are the app's estimate; simulator.json keeps its own model of the farm. Each line also says what it is (T1-38): name (what the app shows), compound (the product or salt), strengthPct (its strength as sold or mixed, % w/v), drum (the container the stock is kept in: id and volumeL), and purpose (what it is dosed for). The pump rate is hardware.json pumps.doseLines.<line>.flowMlPerS, not a copy here.

sources.doseLines.A.ecChangePerMlPerL: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: the same as simulator.json (ecPerGramPerL 1.0 x nutrientGPerMl 0.47), calibrated to contract 6.6's example dose. Needs a jar test of the real stock.
sources.doseLines.A.phChangePerMlPerL: PLACEHOLDER: stock A treated as pH-neutral.
sources.doseLines.B.phChangePerMlPerL: PLACEHOLDER: stock B treated as pH-neutral.
sources.doseLines.ACID.ecChangePerMlPerL: PLACEHOLDER: the acid's own EC contribution is ignored.
sources.doseLines.ACID.phChangePerMlPerL: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.6, 30 mL of acid takes 936 L from pH 6.21 to 6.02 (-0.0059 per mL per 1000 L, so -5.9 per mL per L). Needs a titration of the SIET water with the real acid.
sources.doseLines.*.name: PLACEHOLDER: the handoff's line names, A, B and ACID.
sources.doseLines.*.compound: PLACEHOLDER: a usual two-part hydroponic stock and phosphoric acid, until the SIET stocks are chosen (OPEN-5).
sources.doseLines.*.strengthPct: PLACEHOLDER: 10% for every line until the stock recipes exist.
sources.doseLines.*.drum: PLACEHOLDER: one 200 L stock drum per line, filling the zones' 50 L day-tanks (layout.json).
sources.doseLines.*.purpose: PLACEHOLDER: what an A, B and acid line are usually for.
